title: Emergence — Idea Edge
description: Real shape returned by idea-store's link() -- a real WARP Gate guarded by 3 real hard Axioms (idea:valid-edge-type, idea:from-exists, idea:to-exists -- the last two check live store state via closures, not a cached snapshot). Same EDGE_TYPES vocabulary as the original build-tools/rheon-idea-os/storage/IdeaStore.js.

fromId.description: must reference a real, already-added idea -- enforced by idea:from-exists.

toId.description: must reference a real, already-added idea -- enforced by idea:to-exists.

type.description: enforced by idea:valid-edge-type -- the real EDGE_TYPES vocabulary, unchanged from the original.
